10:2474.name: EXPORT / WBP_AIHUD · v1.3
10:2474.description: ROOT WIDGET BLUEPRINT. Transparent 1920x1080 HUD. Scene/background intentionally omitted. Mission/Location/Minimap/ActionBar/TargetLock stay internal; five child component families map to reusable child Widget Blueprints.

10:2312.name: State=Focus
10:2312.description: WBP_InteractionPrompt — contextual interact hint. Runtime default may be Collapsed.

10:2318.name: State=Default
10:2318.description: WBP_NPCCard — NPC identity, mood, trust and alertness.

10:2370.name: State=Visible
10:2370.description: WBP_EventFeed — perception/world event panel. Enter → Visible models slide/fade animation.

10:2406.name: State=Hover
10:2406.description: WBP_DialoguePanel — one dialogue Widget Blueprint. Variants model option hover/selection, not separate screens.

10:2317.name: WBP_InteractionPrompt · v1.3
10:2317.description: One child Widget Blueprint family. Variants are visual states, not separate Widget Blueprints.

10:2355.name: WBP_NPCCard · v1.3
10:2355.description: One child Widget Blueprint family. TrustGain is a state/animation target.

10:2384.name: WBP_EventFeed · v1.3
10:2384.description: One child Widget Blueprint family. Smart Animate simulates slide-in.

10:2449.name: WBP_DialoguePanel · v1.3
10:2449.description: One child Widget Blueprint family. Default/Hover/Selected are interaction states.

10:2462.name: WBP_RelationshipToast · v1.3
10:2462.description: One child Widget Blueprint family. Enter → Visible models toast animation.
